description: This Java source file implements a builder class for constructing responses related to live modify commands for 'things' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods to create success and error responses, as well as event objects, in a fluent style.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing a builder for creating command responses and events for a 'modify thing' live command in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the ResponseFactory interface, producing success and error responses specific to 'modify thing' commands.

classes.name: EventFactoryImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the EventFactory interface, creating event objects indicating creation or modification of a 'thing'.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a CommandResponse object by applying the provided function with a new ResponseFactoryImpl instance.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates an Event object by applying the provided function with a new EventFactoryImpl instance.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of ModifyThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl with the specified command.
